Flocking on a torus

Eighty boids steering by separation, alignment and cohesion on a world whose edges join.

What to watch for

Follow one boid off the side of the world and back on the other. The space is a torus, so the renderer draws the short way across the seam rather than streaking the whole width. The arrows are each agent's velocity and the force steering it.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (1820 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
